jarvis.menu.enabled.tooltip: Turns Jarvis on or off completely. Off means chat commands and the talk key do nothing.
jarvis.menu.wake_word.tooltip: The word you use to talk to Jarvis in chat, and your friends use in voice chat.
jarvis.menu.echo.tooltip: Shows your question in chat again, only visible to you.
jarvis.menu.listening.tooltip: Tells you in chat when the talk key is recording.
jarvis.menu.speaker: Speaker
jarvis.menu.speaker.none.tooltip: No local voices found, so Jarvis uses the cloud voice.
jarvis.menu.speaker.tooltip: Local German voice. Runs on your PC with no limit. A click switches to the next speaker and plays it right away.
jarvis.menu.test_voice.tooltip: Plays a short sample, also in voice chat if it's turned on.
jarvis.menu.speak.tooltip: When Jarvis answers out loud: only to spoken questions, always or never.
jarvis.menu.use_ai.tooltip: Off means Jarvis only understands fixed commands like /home.
jarvis.menu.model.tooltip: The first model that gets asked. If it fails, another one takes over automatically.
jarvis.menu.hedge.tooltip: If the model doesn't answer within this time, the next one starts in parallel. Shorter is faster but uses more of your limit.
jarvis.menu.web.tooltip: Jarvis may search the web for current questions.
jarvis.menu.memory.tooltip: How many messages Jarvis remembers. 0 means every question stands on its own.
jarvis.menu.last_reply.tooltip: How long the last answer took.
jarvis.menu.commands.tooltip: Jarvis may send commands like /home. If you lack permissions on the server, he blocks operator commands on his own.
jarvis.menu.chat.tooltip: Jarvis may write public messages as you when you ask him to.
jarvis.menu.chestbook.tooltip: Jarvis may look up where your items are and mark chests. Only for you, never for friends in voice chat.
jarvis.menu.servers.tooltip: Jarvis may leave the current world and join another server.
jarvis.menu.broadcast.tooltip: Others hear Jarvis through your voice channel when you're connected and not muted.
jarvis.menu.status.tooltip: Whether Jarvis can talk in voice chat right now.
jarvis.menu.friends.tooltip: Jarvis reacts when someone in voice chat says his wake word. To do that, he recognizes speech locally on your PC. Nothing is saved, only the sentence after the word goes to the AI. Let your friends know first. Friends only get answers, never commands.
jarvis.menu.who.tooltip: Everyone in earshot or only people in your voice chat group.
jarvis.menu.cooldown.tooltip: Minimum gap between two answers to friends, against spam.
jarvis.menu.show_requests.tooltip: Shows you in chat who asked what.
jarvis.menu.recognition.tooltip: State of the local speech recognition.
jarvis.menu.recognition_time.tooltip: How long the local speech recognition took last time.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.jarvis: AI assistant in your client: answers questions, searches the web and sends commands for you.
